title: Dr. Christian
paragraphs: Jean Hersholt stars as Dr. Paul Christian, the physician of the small town of River's End, where medical cases, family conflicts, romances, and community problems become warm dramatic stories, many selected through the program's listener-written script contests.
Jean Hersholt stars as Dr. Paul Christian in River’s End.
The run breaks into several distinct periods: CBS / Vaseline network run (November 7, 1937 to January 6, 1954) on [[org|org.8480b75bc0c36e4b|CBS Radio Network]].

Names that turn up again and again in the surviving run include Jean Hersholt (performer), Rosemary De Camp (performer), Art Gilmore (announcer), Bob Anderson (announcer), Gloria Holden (performer), Helen Claire (performer), and Andre Baruch (announcer).
Across its run, the surviving broadcasts are tied to [[org|org.8480b75bc0c36e4b|CBS Radio Network]].

The stories often return to family conflict and responsibility, children, youth and parenting, romance, courtship and marriage, medical care, illness and treatment, small-town community relationships, and war, military service and veterans.

The show also sits in a wider radio history that includes Listener-written network drama and the Dr. Christian Award, Small-town physician as community moral authority, and Long-form sponsor integration in network radio.

If you are following the same actors and creative circles, related programs worth opening next include [[show|lux-radio-theatre|Lux Radio Theatre]], [[show|yours-truly-johnny-dollar|Yours Truly, Johnny Dollar]], [[show|screen-directors-playhouse|Screen Directors Playhouse]], [[show|the-whistler|The Whistler]], and [[show|broadway-is-my-beat|Broadway Is My Beat]].
